English · 简体中文
# dsh-plugin-subscription-oauth
**Use the AI subscriptions you already pay for as LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness — no API key.**
Sign in once per provider from **Settings → Subscriptions** and that provider's models join the sess
ion model picker, with its plan quota shown live next to the connection. Tokens stay on your machine
; every request streams through the provider's own API.
## Supported providers
| Provider | What you get | Sign-in |
| **Kimi Code** | `kimi-for-coding`, `k3` (1M), `k3-256k` — read from the endpoint's own model list

| OAuth device flow (show code, confirm in browser) |
| **Grok (X Premium)** | whatever the account'
s own model list reports (e.g. `grok-4.7`), **⚡ lightspeed** fast variant | Browser OAuth (auto-redi

rect) |
| **Google Antigravity** | Claude Sonnet/Opus, Gemini Flash, GPT-OSS, with reasoning tiers —

read from the account's own list | Google account OAuth |
| **GLM (BigModel)** | whatever the codin

g host lists (e.g. `glm-5.3`, `glm-5.3-flash`) | ZCode browser sign-in (polled) |
| **Volcengine Ark

** | the plan's own coding models | Volcengine SSO |
| **Xiaomi MiMo** | MiMo's own model list, with

the app's two-model set as the fallback | Xiaomi account (QR / password) |
| **WorkBuddy (国内版)** |
Hy, GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiniMax models | Browser OAuth (Tencent) |
Every provider also feeds the **`auto`** route, which spans them all: pick `auto` and the harness wa
lks your enabled models in order until one answers.
## Features
- **One sign-in per provider** — no API keys to find, paste, or rotate. The plugin runs the provider
's own OAuth/device flow and keeps the token on disk (`~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json`, mode `0

600`).
- **Live plan usage** — the Settings card and the composer chip show each account's remaining
quota (Kimi's 5-hour / weekly windows + credit, Grok's weekly credit, Antigravity's Gemini + Claude

buckets, GLM/Ark/MiMo/WorkBuddy credits), with a meter and reset time.
- **Model picker integration
** — each provider's models appear in the session picker with context windows and reasoning tiers; h

ide or re-order them per provider.
- **Catalogs come from the provider, not from this build** — ever
y route reads its own model list once and caches it as the provider's table, so a model released, re
named or retired server-side shows up (or disappears) without a plugin update. Signing in and the Se

ttings **refresh models** action are what re-read it; browsing the picker never spends a request.
-
**⚡ Fast / lightspeed variants** — for models that have one (e.g. Grok 4.7 → `grok-4.7-build-fast`),
a bolt button beside the model selector switches to the fast variant; it reads as a reasoning rung

so the base model always stays selectable.
- **Cross-account pool** — sign in to several accounts on

one provider; the plugin draws on the next account when one's allowance runs out.
- **Auto fallback
** — `auto` moves to the next enabled model when a provider refuses the preferred one (renamed, rate
-limited, out of quota), and stops falling back once a stream has started.

## How to use
1. **Open Settings → Subscriptions.** You see one card per provider; signed-in providers sort to the

front, `auto` leads.
2. **Connect** a provider. A browser window (or a device code) starts the prov

ider's own sign-in. Finish it there — the card updates by itself.
3. **Pick a model.** The provider'

s models now appear in the composer model picker, and the chip shows live usage.
4. **Expand a card*
* to manage accounts (set default, sign out, refresh token), toggle which models appear, re-order th
em, add a model id this build doesn't know yet, and see the credential file / endpoints.
> **Tip:** to use a different account on a provider, sign out first, then connect again — the browse
r sign-in follows whichever account the provider's page is signed in with.
## What it registers
| Surface | What appears |
| `ctx.llm` | the `kimi`, `grok`, `antigravity`, `glm`, `ark`, `mimo`, `workbuddy` and `auto` provid

er routes (models, reasoning, streaming) |
| Settings | a **Subscriptions** section: one card per pr

ovider |
| Model picker | each provider's own models, plus **`auto`** spanning them all |
| Composer
chip | live plan usage for the provider in force |
## Hiding a provider
To keep a provider's models out of the picker without uninstalling, drop it from the route list in y
our profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Omit the ones you don't want. The list defaults to every implemented route.
## Security
- Credentials are stored locally at `~/.dsh/plugins/kimi-oauth/auth.json` (mode `0600`, written atom

ically), one section per provider.
- The plugin talks only to the providers' own hosts and OAuth end

points — no telemetry, no third-party relay.
- Your subscriptions only; nothing is shared across mac

— no telemetry, no third-party relay.
- Your subscriptions only; nothing is shared across machines.
